# Dr. Mihail Kantor

**Assistant Research Professor**
Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology
The Pennsylvania State University

* [Penn State Research profile](https://pure.psu.edu/en/persons/mihail-kantor)
* [Kantor Plant-Parasitic Nematodes Lab](https://plantpath.psu.edu/research/labs/kantor-plant-parasitic-nematodes-lab)

---

## Biography

Dr. Mihail Kantor is an Assistant Research Professor in the Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology at Penn State University. He is also affiliated with the Huck Institutes of the Life Sciences, the Plant Institute, and the One Health Microbiome Center.

His research focuses on plant-parasitic nematodes, emerging nematode threats, disease diagnostics, plant–nematode interactions, and the ecology and management of nematode-associated plant diseases. His program combines plant pathology, nematology, microscopy, molecular diagnostics, microbiome approaches, and field-based research.

---

## Collaborations

Dr. Kantor collaborates with the Briseño Lab on pathogen detection, host-associated microbiomes and viromes, disease diagnostics, forest-health surveillance, and interactions among nematodes, microbes, and plant hosts.
